result.interpretation: Only the positive initial codeword is integrated. Zero memory drive gives exact unitary memory-parity symmetry, so negative-codeword wrong probability is identical.

measurement-idle.logical_symmetry: Only sign +1 was numerically integrated. Conjugation by memory parity maps the undriven + codeword evolution to the - codeword evolution, giving identical wrong populations. This is covariance of the Lindbladian, not conservation of parity under single-photon loss.

trajectory_comparison.interpolation: Segmentwise quintic mean-observable interpolation, partitioned at all physical drive switches; no interpolation of density matrices and no extrapolation.
trajectory_comparison.warning: Naive linear resampling gives an apparent 2.23e-5 buffer difference on dissimilar output grids; it does not measure solver error.

local_noise.formula: C(tau)=Tr[(c+c.dag) exp(L*tau)(c*rho+rho*c.dag-Tr[(c+c.dag)*rho]*rho)], c=sqrt(kappa_b)*b. Vacuum delta noise excluded.
local_noise.assumptions: Covariance is centered exactly about a finite-time branch reference; the boxcar formula additionally assumes local stationarity. The diagnostic is not the variance of a full readout cycle or proof of a Gaussian distribution.
local_noise.reference: Positive coherent codeword at t=0, vacuum buffer, evolve 4 us under constant readout controls. Na=28,Nb=10, BDF rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-12; delays linspace(0,2,1001) us.

model_definitions.phase6: ATS-pump-only correction, with external microwave ports treated after their RWA; mixed pump/control counter-rotating corrections are omitted. Every second-pump-order van-Vleck product with total zero-point-phase order <=6, including linear-times-fifth and cubic-times-cubic. Complete at that phase order; correction is diagonal.
model_definitions.first_order_exchange: Resonant all-phase ATS sine exchange, using exact infinite-Fock Laguerre matrix elements and the finite fundamental-pump 2J1(epsilon_p)/epsilon_p factor. Buffer drive cancels its coherent expectation at the chosen target alpha.
model_definitions.static_balance: Physical DC ATS junction-imbalance term C cos(Phi), C=-2 DeltaEJ J0(epsilon_p). Phase6 uses cosine through phase4 because chosen C is O(epsilon_p^2 phi^2). DeltaEJ=(EJ1-EJ2)/2, EJ=(EJ1+EJ2)/2.
model_definitions.sine_diagonal: All-phase pump-fundamental VV diagonal only; omits off-diagonal two-pump resonances and is not a complete all-phase Hamiltonian.
model_definitions.sine_full: ATS-pump-only correction, with external microwave ports treated after their RWA; mixed pump/control counter-rotating corrections are omitted. Full all-phase pump-fundamental VV projected after padded-virtual-state Fourier commutators, with exact resonant static cosine. Virtual matrix elements are infinite-Fock displacement elements; default virtual_extra=12. Higher pump harmonics, higher van-Vleck orders and bath dressing are omitted.
model_definitions.calibration: Subtract the constant and linear Stark shifts and track the local coherent mean slopes. Phase6 compensated HK is Ka na(na-1)+Kb nb(nb-1)+chi na nb -2Ka alpha^2 na-chi alpha^2 nb. The large frequency offsets are physical calibration costs.
model_definitions.bit_rate: Decay exponent of the physical Re<a> difference between the two initial coherent codewords; in a two-state reduction it is k_plus_to_minus+k_minus_to_plus. Kerr generally breaks equal-direction switching symmetry.
model_definitions.certificate: Full real trace-zero Hermitian Liouvillian including coupled symmetric and antisymmetric density sectors. The idle odd-memory-operator restriction is exact. Left/right eigenpairs and physical initial/observable loading certify the relevant mode; numerical residuals do not bound model remainder.

full_sine_field_comparison.scope: Finite-time output mean-quadrature separation at 4 us in the full-phase pump-fundamental model; no full-sine rare-switching or measurement-fidelity certificate.

checks: Dense full-complex Liouvillian spectrum and RHS

validation.provenance_limit: Early runs did not capture executed-source hashes; embedded native records retain their original numerical metadata. Current-source hashes identify the aggregation version, not retrospectively the source used for every run.

conclusions.status: Completed, cutoff-qualified effective-model witness; no bound on the exact open-circuit rate.
conclusions.supported: Balanced conservative readout has a lower certified physical bit-mode relaxation exponent than the same-hardware idle reference at every saved witness cutoff. This is a systematically truncated model result with observed cutoff differences, not a hardware guarantee.
conclusions.cutoff_qualification: Last memory increment at Nb=10: Na36 to38 changes Gamma by2.4875% relative38. Buffer increment at Na32: Nb10 to12 changes Gamma by4.6868% relative12. There is no combined38x12 point; these separate checks do not prove a uniform cutoff bound. Idle Na28 to32 atNb10 differs0.0822%; idle buffer convergence was not separately tested.
conclusions.model_qualification: Full-phase pump-fundamental finite-time fields retain2.65x information-metric improvement, but no full-sine rare-switching calculation or fidelity certificate was performed. Initial unbalanced diagonal-only screens are explicitly nonconverged and cannot establish matched hardware mitigation benefit.
conclusions.scope: Systematically truncated effective-Hamiltonian design witness, not an exact open GHz circuit or fabrication guarantee. Cancellations are sensitive to higher phase orders. No hardware-robustness claim follows from an eigenvalue residual. Completeness applies to the ATS pump interaction only; mixed pump/microwave counter-rotating terms at the retained combined order have not been simulated.

omitted_mixed_control_corrections.order: Same combined second-pump/sixth-phase order when epsilon_z and epsilon_d scale with g2.
omitted_mixed_control_corrections.rate_effect: Not evaluated; a small Hamiltonian coefficient does not bound its effect on exponentially rare switching.
